item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J01925","case1_error":"Reverses Ida’s comparison, subtracting $30 instead of adding; then assigns unsupported dress prices.","case2_error":"Evaluates the correctly written expression 12 + 6 − 1 + 5 − 2 as 18 instead of 20.","reason":"Case 1 mistranslates a relationship and substitutes unsupported values; case 2 incorrectly evaluates a correct expression.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01926","case1_error":"Reduces the required rope length by 25% instead of accounting for loss in the purchased rope.","case2_error":"Gives unsupported final value 450 after correctly specifying revenue, expenditure, and subtraction; the result should be 75.","reason":"Case 1 uses an incorrect loss relationship; case 2 supplies an incorrect final number without showing its calculation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01927","case1_error":"Treats 15 training days per stage as 15 weeks, failing to divide 45 training days by five.","case2_error":"Treats two extra red pencils as two total red pencils, omitting each special pack’s original red pencil.","reason":"Case 1 fails to convert days to weeks; case 2 confuses an additional amount with a total.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01928","case1_error":"Reverses the twice-as-many relationship, multiplying Emmy’s remaining count by two to obtain Rosa’s count instead of dividing.","case2_error":"Defines donations as pre-pie remainder minus post-pie remainder, which measures pie usage; also reports dozens rather than individual eggs.","reason":"Case 1 reverses a comparative relationship. Case 2 subtracts the remaining amount to calculate usage, coincidentally matching donations, and omits conversion to eggs.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01929","case1_error":"Omits Bexley’s nine fish from the total before halving, then arbitrarily rounds the resulting fractional gift.","case2_error":"Correctly finds ten cakes remaining, then reports the complementary fifty already baked as the amount still needed.","reason":"Case 1 fails to incorporate added fish into the total; case 2 answers the complementary quantity after correctly calculating the requested remainder.","judgment":"different"}]}
